datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Mozambique on a monthly basis throughout 2012. Geographic data representing food insecurity phases and scenarios were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) for January, April, July, and October 2012, providing near-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions at the sub-national level.
